Return a bounded inventory of discoverable operations, ownership, and execution availability.

Usage:
  tadx capability list [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

Flags:
  --domain <string>  filter by exact command domain (alias: --dom)
  -l, --limit <1..10000> (default: 20)  maximum capabilities to return, up to 10000 (alias: --lim)
  --mutation[=true|false] (default: false)  filter by remote mutation status (alias: --mut)
  --owner <string>  filter by exact owner (alias: --own)
  --product <string>  filter by product availability (alias: --prd)
  --resource <string>  filter by exact resource (alias: --res)

Global Flags:
  --config <string>  path to the non-secret TADX configuration file (alias: --cfg)
  -f, --full[=true|false] (default: false)  show expanded bounded details (alias: --ful)
  --json[=true|false] (default: false)  render machine-readable JSON instead of TOON (alias: --jsn)
  -h, --help  Show help for this command.
